elements.label: Mouse cursor
Hovered row highlight (Import Actuals from Workday via CCDS)
Transient hover highlights on rows passed by the cursor

pattern.description: The cursor glides down a task list in a real product screen; each row it crosses lights up with a hover band until it settles on the target row 'Import Actuals from Workday via CCDS'.
pattern.why_premium: The hover band travels row by row with the pointer, so the viewer's eye is led to the exact integration task the narration names ('integrates') without any added overlay.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.fromTo('.cursor', {y: -100}, {y: 0, duration: 0.33, ease: 'power2.out'}); row highlights as a timeline of instant set() calls: tl.set('.row', {backgroundColor: 'transparent'}).set('.row:nth-child(n)', {backgroundColor: '#d5d9e0'}) at the moment the cursor y crosses each row (about 80 ms apart); tooltip gsap.set('.tooltip', {autoAlpha: 0}) at start.
build_hint.remotion: Cursor y = interpolate(frame, [0, 10], [-100, 0], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); highlighted row index = the row under cursor y, background toggled with no easing; tooltip opacity 0 from frame 1.

notes: Screen-recorded UI hover, not designed motion. The small column-header tooltip visible at f617 near b04 is illegible at filmstrip size, so it is marked non-text. b02 also contains the header row, which does not change.
